observations: Two photos show a set of multiple English-language self-help/business/relationship books laid on a tiled floor.

Visible titles include: “How to Influence People”, “Small Business Big Money”, “The Millionaire Next Door”, “Compound Effect”, “This Is Marketing”, “Zero to One”, “How to Speak and Think”, “Women Rise Up”, “Sell Like Crazy”, “Seth Godin”, “Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “Words Matter”, “Money”, and others.
Some covers appear slightly worn/handled, but overall condition is not clearly measurable from these images.
No clear count of total books beyond what is visible in the photos; no close-ups of spines/ISBNs/editions.

claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show multiple books with motivational/self-help, business/marketing, and relationship/marriage themes on the covers.

risks.risk: Exact number of books and whether any are missing compared to what the seller intends to sell.
risks.proof: A single photo showing all books laid out with a visible count (or a list of titles) plus a photo of the full stack from top to bottom.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the visible set only (worst case: fewer books than expected).

risks.risk: Condition issues (missing pages, torn covers, water damage, heavy highlighting/notes) that photos may not reveal.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of 2–3 random books’ inner pages (first page, middle page, and last page) showing any damage/notes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/possibly imperfect condition (worst case: not pristine).

risks.risk: Editions/versions may differ (some titles can have multiple editions), affecting resale value.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the back cover or copyright/ISBN page for 2–3 representative books.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without assuming premium editions (worst case: standard/unknown editions).

risks.risk: Authenticity risk (rare but possible with books): counterfeit or photocopied copies.
risks.proof: Photo of ISBN/copyright page for at least 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as genuine only if proven; otherwise treated as lower-value used copies.

proof_requests: Confirm the exact number of books included (and list titles) and send one photo showing the full set together.
Send close-ups of the ISBN/copyright pages for 2–3 books.
Send close-ups of inner pages (first/middle/last) for 2–3 books to confirm condition (no missing pages/water damage/major notes).
response.reason: The photos support that it’s a mixed set of motivational/business/relationship books, but the exact quantity, edition/ISBN details, and true condition aren’t verifiable from these images—those factors strongly affect the resale price in Oyo.
